shots.camText: Opens exactly on Q01 t1's frame 391 (16.29 s): the gallery, the congregation opposite · the drift continues
shots.line: (no words) The congregation still after its answer.
shots.note: One bar. The start frame is the take's own; the join is a 2–3-frame dissolve.

shots.camText: Serath among the admirals · 40 mm · from the tower side, slightly high, the congregation behind them · the camera glides 1 m left
shots.line: Grand Admiral Serath among the admirals, the gold collar at her throat; the petal girl beside her.
shots.note: Villeneuve: one figure isolated in white on white. She watches the rite the way she would watch a harbour.

shots.camText: The basket · 40 mm · eye height, from the tower side · locked off
shots.line: The girl trips; the basket leaves her hands and drifts; Serath takes it out of the air without looking, and gives it back.
shots.note: Above, things fall slowly: the basket drifts as if under water. Her eyes stay on the tower.

shots.camText: The hand · 85 mm · close, shallow focus · locked off
shots.line: The aide holds out the warrant and red wax; her gloved hand presses the ring into the wax without reading.
shots.note: The hand thread, gloved: it seals. The same close shot and size as the bare hand (Q11), the raised and flat hands (Q17), the girl's palms (Q25).

shots.camText: The release · 20 mm · from the nave floor, low · held, locked off
shots.line: The aide lifts the sealed warrant toward the tower. Above, the barge lets go: the chains run slack and fall in long loops; the bell settles onto the beam.
shots.note: Two bars, a held wide (Villeneuve). Cameron: a ship's crane setting a load on a quay. Release at 1.5 s; by 4 s the chains hang loose and the bell rests on the beam. The guests tiny below.

shots.camText: The hammer · 35 mm · level with the bell, side on, wide enough for the whole bell and the whole hammer · locked off
shots.line: A hammer the size of a door is drawn back on its ropes.
shots.note: Its iron head as long as a door, half the bell's height; two ropes haul it up and back. Cameron: a real church striker on ropes.

shots.camText: The strike · 28 mm · from the aisle, looking up at the tower · locked off
shots.line: The hammer swings in and strikes the bell's side at 0.8 s; the bell shudders; the camera holds.
shots.note: The climax early in its shot, then a hold (lesson 3). In the montage, this cuts to Anvil Vale (Q03).

shots.camText: The still cup · 85 mm · top-down insert · locked off
shots.line: The bell's note is still in the air. A gold cup of wine on a gallery rail; gloved hands applauding, almost soundless, behind. The wine's surface is perfectly still.
shots.note: The water thread's first insert: still above. Q04 opens on the same insert, the wine trembling.
